assets.name: PageSelection
assets.description: A data-scoped current-page aggregate checkbox that preserves locked and outside-page selections.
useWhen: A finite current page has a known eligible ID set.
doNotUseWhen: All remote filtered results, virtualized discovery, a tree or Shift range selection is required.

allowed: Replace fictional example data and content.

assets.name: Attachment Workflow
assets.description: 附件选择、校验、上传草稿、取消重试、原位替换、异步移除、列表与有限预览的公共组合。
